cafe: Synthetic Dubai Chewy Cookie café adapted from the original teaching environment. State: hour and cookie stock; Poisson customer demand is the only uncertainty; preparation always succeeds; no ingredient budget. Selling hours 10:00–19:00, closing 20:00. Assumed demand peaks at 12:00 (4 customers/hour) and 18:00 (3 customers/hour). Product-label revision only: prices, demand, dynamics, measured results and checkpoint Q/visit arrays are unchanged. These are teaching assumptions, not real sales or market data.
figures: PNG overview illustrations generated with the built-in image_gen tool using the user's supplied line-art image as a style reference. Black/white/grey context with a brown Dubai Chewy Cookie/demand curve in the cafe, a brown RL-controlled car in highway, and selective blue/pink highlights in the social games. The cafe demand curve is a qualitative schematic; Prisoner's Dilemma payoff labels match the upstream matrix. These are conceptual illustrations, not rollout screenshots or measured plots.
simple_spread: MPE2 0.0.1 installed from official PyPI; N=3, local_ratio=0.0, discrete actions, 60 steps. Upstream physics and reward are unmodified. The clustered start is a teaching fixture. Fixed nearest steering and centralized assignment are labelled references; learned MAPPO uses skrl 1.4.3.
highway_rendering: Actual HighwayEnv RGB pixels rendered on an offscreen surface. The project wrapper enables drawing under the SDL dummy driver; only vehicle colours are changed (controlled car brown, other traffic grey). Simulation, observations, rewards, cached comparison measurements and the supplied DQN checkpoint are unchanged.

highway_sb3_study.note: Five new SB3 DQN models; verified tabular/baseline records reused. Historical hand-coded cache preserved.

multi_agent_learning.note: Genuine locally trained policies; notebooks load frozen policies. MAPPO learning uses installed skrl 1.4.3. The improved model shares parameters, appends distances derived only from existing observations, and uses library time-limit bootstrapping. Three development configurations used 3,000,000 joint steps each; selected checkpoint at 2,400,960 steps of the chosen run. Final evaluation on 50 reserved starts followed selection. Original reward and physics are unchanged; the clustered recording scene was practiced during training. Previous model and integration source remain separately archived.
